# AWS input oracle

`vectors.json` records actual AWS CLI **2.31.18** parsing, flag naming and model
skeleton output, generated by `generate.py`. Parser source hashes are enforced
before generation and stored with the fixtures. The packaged model plus SDK
overlay are the same pinned inputs as the CLI catalog. All input values are
synthetic, and generation makes no service requests.

After capturing the source archive and installing the temporary reference
dependencies described in the sibling SigV4 fixture README, regenerate with:

```sh
PYTHONPATH=/tmp/ess-cli-reference-m0/aws-cli-2.31.18:/tmp/ess-cli-reference-m0/aws-cli-2.31.18/awscli:/tmp/ess-sigv4-reference-deps python3 apps/ex_storage_service_cli/test/fixtures/aws_input/generate.py
```

Neither the CLI nor its Elixir tests require Python or reference downloads.
